items.title: Eddie Bert interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: The rhythm was Shelly Manne, Bob Carter on bass and Lou Levy on piano. Bill Harris, me and Milty Gold.

ctx.x: All right. ’47. What did you think of his music?

Well he featured trombones. That’s why I wanted to go with that band. And he was very popular. I mean guys were poll winners in the band, like Shelly Manne and Art Pepper and all them. So I figured well let me go. Because Kai had done great on the band and Kai and I were friends. So I went with the band. And it was like a family that band. It was great. He was a great guy to work for. Great.
Some people didn’t think he swung very good.
